chunks: Discard the visible and invisible sin. Indeed, those who earn sin will be recompensed for what they used to commit.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between visible and invisible sin in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to distinguish between 'zahir al-ithm' (external, observable sins) and 'batin al-ithm' (internal, hidden sins like hypocrisy or neglect of duties), emphasizing comprehensive moral vigilance. It underscores the principle of 'adl' (divine justice), where the recompense precisely mirrors the nature and extent of the accumulated deeds, a concept frequently cited by Imams to encourage both public piety and private sincerity.
